results.summary_before: This project implements a (7,4) Hamming encoder and decoder with a shared input bus, where the mode is selected by the most significant input bit. In encode mode, it takes a 4-bit input and produces a 7-bit encoded output; in decode mode, it takes a 7-bit input and outputs the corrected 7-bit codeword. Testing involves applying known data and verifying the encoded output, then flipping one bit in the encoded input to confirm error correction. No external hardware is specified, and the design is a straightforward implementation of a classic error-correcting code.

results.summary_before: This design is a 12-hour clock rendered on a 640x480 VGA display using a race-the-beam triangle renderer, where three triangle hands indicate the time and twelve dots aid readability. It uses the Tiny VGA pinout and requires a 31.5 MHz clock, reset, and hour and minute advance buttons. Silicon test reports confirm it works out of the box with a Tiny VGA Pmod, with testers noting the hands move correctly and the time can be set by holding the buttons. The design is notable for its triangle-based rendering approach and includes a Rust software model for reference.

results.summary_before: This design measures the frequency of an input signal and displays the result on a dual seven-segment display. It debounces the input, counts transitions over a configurable period, and divides the count by ten for display. The period can be set via input pins to match the clock frequency for accurate measurements. It requires a dual seven-segment PMOD and a frequency source, and includes a debug mode for monitoring internal state.

results.summary_before: This project implements a simple RISC-V processor that fetches 16-bit instructions, decodes them, performs ALU operations, and writes back to a register file. The design is a basic educational core that supports a subset of instructions and can be expanded with memory operations and additional control logic. It is intended to be tested with cocotb by applying various instruction sequences and checking the results. The documentation notes that it is not a complete processor and lacks memory operations.
